problem_statement: An IPv6 prefix constructed from a 16-byte source buffer using a prefix length greater than 128 bits reads and writes beyond the source buffer and corrupts adjacent memory. Constructing a Prefix with a length above 128 (e.g. 129, 136, 200, 255) must not read more than the available source bytes, must not overwrite adjacent memory during construction or tidying, and must report the resulting prefix as invalid while preserving the original length and bytes.
oracle_note: observed by validate_instance.py (fail before, pass after the fix); the unit oracle is per executable, so check attribution of the cases to the PR's change
